headline: Argentina's Treasury Rolls Over Debt in 26.7 Trillion Peso Auction
summary: Argentina's Secretariat of Finance successfully renewed all maturing debt by securing 26.71 trillion pesos in a local auction, absorbing liquidity using fixed-rate, inflation-linked, and dollar-linked instruments.
why: Local debt auctions are vital for monitoring sovereign liquidity management and domestic debt sustainability in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Successful debt rollovers reduce near-term default risks for the sovereign.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Surpassing maturity obligations and withdrawing liquidity from the market signals strong local debt uptake.
